animations.name: dig
animations.loop: seamless linear loop (last key = first key, 0.0 deg); in place (root not animated, pelvis x/z offsets only)
animations.godot_loop_mode: LINEAR (set by import option; glTF has no loop flag)
animations.first_pose: r002 idle t=0 (0.0 deg / 0.0 m difference from r002 idle first key)
animations.last_pose: r002 idle t=0 (0.0 deg / 0.0 m difference from r002 idle first key)
animations.behaviour: R: from idle the worker lifts the stick (two-handed, right hand on tool_hold, left hand lower), takes 3 thrust-and-lever strokes into the pit wall at dig_target (1.0 s each, thrust accelerates into the bite, lever back, withdraw), returns to idle. Tip penetrates the pit surface up to 0.035 m (fresh) / 0.009 m (worked) at the bite.

animations.name: plaster
animations.loop: seamless linear loop (last key = first key, 0.0 deg); in place (root not animated, pelvis x/z offsets only)
animations.godot_loop_mode: LINEAR (set by import option; glTF has no loop flag)
animations.behaviour: R: left palm braced on the wall at ~1.2 m, right palm smears three strokes over the patch (down, up, up) at 0.79-1.32 m above the floor; palm-to-wall-plane 11.9-14.3 mm while in contact (patch surface is 4-17.6 mm proud, so the palm presses into the wet daub); hands approach and leave along a straight path that never crosses the wall plane

animations.name: tread_mix
animations.loop: seamless linear loop (last key = first key, 0.0 deg); in place (root not animated, pelvis x/z offsets only)
animations.godot_loop_mode: LINEAR (set by import option; glTF has no loop flag)
animations.behaviour: R: in-place treading/kneading of the mix: alternate small steps (lift <=~0.1 m) with a twist of the planted foot; soles sink 4.7-8 mm into the mix surface on daub_mix_patch.tread_stand

deviations: pit roots are named CLAY_PIT_FRESH / CLAY_PIT_WORKED (and heaps/patches likewise per state); origin, transform (identity) and anchor names are identical across states, but the glTF root node names differ

ground-hugging / overlay meshes (pits, daub_mix_patch, wall patches) need cast_shadow OFF in Godot: with default shadow casting the single-sided pit bowl self-shadows into large acne blotches (previews/godot_pits_ortho6_cast_shadow_on_acne.png). Heaps, stick and person cast normally.
the host terrain must be cut under each pit (checks/ground_cut.json outline); the preview yard leaves those ground cells open
the brief counts kit materials <=3: the props use 2 (CLAY_kit, CLAY_wet); person_clay keeps r002 body/garment, so the full kit inventory is 4 unique materials
